summary: Submitted a frequency execution for the heartbeat term race: 200 natural-timing attempts and 200 attempts with 0-2 ms stable-store jitter, each racing a fast-path heartbeat at term cur+1 against a cur+2 AppendEntries through the real consumer path, with the same no-decrease invariant asserted under both admission modes. Native feedback showed one inversion without any store delay and 94 with jitter, so the forced ordering used earlier may not be necessary; the retained receipt will decide that.
